summary: Intercont (Cayman) Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, announcing the resignation of three independent directors (Dahong Li, Michael Schumann, Yuanmei Ma) effective August 5, 2026, citing personal reasons and no disagreement with the company. Simultaneously, the company appointed three new independent directors (Chan Kelvin Zhi Hong, Lee Chee Wai, Wong Khai Meng) effective the same date. The resignations triggered committee vacancies, which were presumably filled by the new appointees. This is a significant board overhaul, potentially signaling governance changes. Watch for further 6-K filings detailing any strategic shifts, regulatory scrutiny, or operational impacts arising from this rapid board transition.
